entries.claim: A real teacher wrote the text-to-SQL training data
entries.evidence: Nemotron 3 Ultra on Nebius Token Factory wrote the databases, questions and SQL. Every SQL query ran in a sandbox and was kept only if it ran and returned rows. 821 training rows; 172 exam rows from held-out database domains.

check.label: Read the generator: a query is kept only if it runs and returns rows

entries.claim: A LoRA adapter was trained on that data
entries.evidence: Trained on a free Google Colab T4 GPU, not on Nebius GPUs: a 4-bit LoRA (r=16) on Nemotron 3 Nano 4B, 206 steps over 2 epochs in 66 minutes. Training loss went from 0.334 to 0.075; a training loss is not a quality result.

check.label: Read the training script that ran on the T4

entries.claim: How well the adapter does on the held-out exam
entries.evidence: Being measured now: the base model and the adapter answer the 172 held-out exam rows, and every number is computed from those answers by one script.

check.label: Recompute the numbers from the raw answers, once they are published

entries.claim: The adapter and its dataset on Hugging Face
entries.evidence: To be published under the harshbhx account: the adapter as harshbhx/ratchet-nemotron-nano-4b-text2sql and the synthetic data as harshbhx/ratchet-text2sql-synthetic. Not published yet.

check.label: The account the two repositories will appear under

entries.claim: The gateway in live mode on Nebius
entries.evidence: Live mode (the student on a Nebius endpoint and the teacher on Token Factory, through the gateway) and its day-1 checks have not been run yet.

check.label: The day-1 checks, with a Token Factory key

entries.evidence: Scout runs on a mock research world in the demo. Recorded live runs with real Tavily searches are planned.

entries.claim: The demo and the dashboard numbers
entries.evidence: The demo at demo.ratchet.dualmindlab.tech runs in mock mode on a Cloudflare Container: mock models answer every request, and the story page replays the reference run. None of these numbers measures a real model.

entries.claim: The cascade, release gate, signed BOM, certificates and receipts
entries.evidence: Real as code and tests (more than 1,900 automated tests, no network and no GPU), shown here in simulation.

entries.claim: Only open teachers: the license-clean rule
entries.evidence: Enforced in code: every teacher passes the license registry, and closed models are refused as teachers.
